facts.fact: Mauritania's minister of digital transformation said the border-area coverage project, covering more than 200 villages, had all four components completed on 26 July (2024), after the President inaugurated it at Kaedi.

Government spokesman Nani Ould Chrouga defended the July 2024 internet cut as subject to legal procedures and a security necessity, and the digital minister said he hoped service would soon be restored.

MRT.note: Document says nothing on school internet or digital curriculum.
